Full Stack Engineer (AI Products) - Lumen Labs

We're hiring a Full Stack Engineer to build AI-powered features for our B2B SaaS platform.

Responsibilities:
- Build responsive user interfaces with React, Next.js and TypeScript.
- Design and ship REST APIs and microservices in Python (FastAPI) and Node.js.
- Integrate LLM APIs (OpenAI, Gemini) including prompt engineering and RAG pipelines with vector databases.
- Own CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions; deploy containerized services with Docker and Kubernetes on AWS.
- Write automated tests and champion code quality through code reviews.
- Monitor performance and reliability in production.

Requirements:
- 3+ years of professional full stack experience.
- Strong JavaScript/TypeScript and Python.
- Experience with PostgreSQL and Redis.
- Familiarity with Agile/Scrum.
Nice to have: Tailwind CSS, GraphQL, observability tools (Datadog).
